body.statement: For \(N\ge2k_\alpha\), the construction in \(\operatorname{def:robust-observed-moments}\) satisfies \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal M}\Pr_P\{\|\widehat\theta-\theta(P)\|_{\mathsf m}\le\widehat\rho_N\}\ge1-\alpha\) and \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal M}\mathbb E_P[\|\widehat\theta-\theta(P)\|_{\mathsf m}+\widehat\rho_N]\le K_\alpha N^{-1/2}\). The construction is total for \(N\ge2k_\alpha\), so \(\Pr_P(\mathsf F_N)=0\) for every \(P\in\mathcal M\) and all such \(N\).
body.justification: The lemma supplies the explicit finite-sample coverage and first-moment radius control needed for honest inversion and expected-width analysis under the declared \(4+\delta\) moment bound.
body.gap: Generic weak-identification references do not furnish a simultaneous robust ball for the cohort probabilities, first moments, and second moments under the panel's common finite-moment radius.
body.consumer: The guarantee makes moment inversion a fully specified confidence procedure rather than an oracle-radius feasibility device.
